title: celmisia hieracioides
intro: Celmisia hieracioides, commonly known as Woolly-head or Alpine Daisy, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for soothing various health issues such as skin irritations and wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Celmisia hieracioides include astringent, demulcent, and vulnerary effects, which contribute to its ability to protect and heal tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
